==Summary==

{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}

Elayne travels with [[Merilille Ceandevin]] to meet with the Borderlander rulers that are near Andor in Braem Wood. [[Aviendha]] and [[Birgitte]] are against her going without more arrangements for her safety being made. Elayne chooses to meet the rulers as an Aes Sedai rather than as Daughter-heir and only brings Aviendha and Birgitte with her. Some Shienaran soldiers meet them outside of camp and assure their safety until they leave. At the camp Elayne meets with [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]], [[Tenobia si Bashere Kazadi]], [[Easar Togita]] and [[Paitar Nachiman]]. They are looking for the Dragon Reborn and hope Elayne knows where he is. Elayne plans to have the Borderland army move into Andor so that other noble houses will unite with Elayne to repel them as invaders since they won't know Elayne has already negotiated a truce. Tenobia expresses a strong interest in meeting up with her uncle, [[Davram t'Ghaline Bashere]].

With the agreement made Elayne weaves a gateway near to Caemlyn so they can return, after putting some distance from the Borderlander camp. At the palace [[Norry]] insists on speaking to Elayne even though she is almost falling asleep. There are four armies approaching Caemlyn totaling twenty to thirty thousand men. Elayne orders all food outside the walls to be purchased and brought in and mercenaries that don't join the guard to leave the city.
